payload.claim: The comment "A task holding either names a row that is its own" elides the noun after "either" (a run fact / a run fact kind). Every other new comment or docstring in this diff that makes the same point spells it out in full - `_own_run_for`'s docstring says "A task whose own facts hold a run fact never shares a row by `base_sha`", `_run_for`'s says "`exclude_keys` names every task whose own facts hold a run fact", and `fold_task`'s says "`run_fact_keys` names every task across the whole record whose own facts hold a run fact." This one line breaks that pattern and reads as a dangling pronoun with no antecedent in the sentence itself.
